targets.query:
from(bucket: "loxone") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "loxone" and r._field == "value" and r.type == "Meter" and r.state == "actual")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _field: r.control}))
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "_field"])

from(bucket: "loxone") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "loxone" and r._field == "value" and r.type == "Meter" and r.state == "total")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1d, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> difference(nonNegative: true)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _field: r.control}))
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "_field"])

from(bucket: "loxone") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "loxone" and r._field == "value" and r.type == "Meter" and r.state == "total")
  |> last()
  |> keep(columns: ["control", "_value"])
  |> group()
